entries.name: Otto's Noodle Bar
entries.speciality: Hand-pulled noodles. Order the dan dan, ask for it extra numbing.

reviews.note: Went at 9pm on a Tuesday, no wait. The chili oil alone is worth the trip.

entries.name: Marigold Cafe
entries.speciality: Weekend brunch. The shakshuka and the burnt-honey latte.

reviews.note: Solid, but gets loud after 11am. Go early.

entries.name: Riverside Promenade
entries.speciality: Quiet at sunset, good for a walk after a heavy meal.

reviews.note: The light around 7pm in autumn is unreasonable.

entries.name: Old Town Bookshop
entries.speciality: Deep used-fiction section, ask the owner for a recommendation.

reviews.note: Lost an hour in the poetry shelf. In a good way.

entries.name: Sunday Pottery Studio
entries.speciality: Drop-in wheel sessions, no booking needed before 11am.

reviews.note: Messier than expected, in the best way. Wear old clothes.

relations.note: Five minute walk, good for post-dinner
